{{Quote|In future, you might want to prime your weapon ''before'' you tough talk an opponent... Just in case he's packing ''smoke grenades''!|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], to [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories">{{TCWComicCite|6.41|Mandalorian Memories}}</ref>}}
'''Smoke grenades''' or '''smoke bombs''' were a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] that released clouds of thick smoke to obscure the vision of enemies.

==Description==
[[File:Smoke_bomb.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A stormtrooper using a smoke bomb during an assault]]
Smoke grenades (called "smokers" in military jargon) released a cloud of obscuring smoke that lasted for one minute.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> They had a variety of uses, such as marking target zones for incoming vessels,<ref name="EGWT" /> aerial attacks, or evacuation.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> They were also used to obscure the vision of enemy [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="EGWT" />

The [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[Nacht-5 smoke grenade]]s used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] were modified to release [[Color/Legends|colored]] smoke, such as red, green, or blue.<ref name="Rebel SpecForce Handbook">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> Smoke grenades could either be thrown or launched from a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]].

==History==
A smoke grenade was carried by [[Loodux]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] that was hired to kill [[Tsillog]], a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]]. He planned to use it to create chaos among the assembled crowd, at which point he would line up his shot to kill the ambassador. However, Loodux's assassination attempt failed and he was defeated by a group of agents.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>
